_readme: CENTRAL OVERRIDE TEMPLATE for the Orca terminal-theme loader.
This directory (~/.config/orca/themes/) is a machine-local OVERRIDE store.
The PRIMARY home for a repo's theme is IN THE REPO itself, committed at
Only put a file HERE when you cannot commit to the repo, or want to retune a
repo's colors on THIS machine only. A file here WINS over the repo's committed
file (git-config model: a deliberate local override beats the shared default).
TO USE: copy this file to  <displayName>.json  where <displayName> is the repo's
Orca displayName exactly as it appears in `orca repo list` (this is the loader's
lookup key -- NOT the folder name, NOT the project field below). Example:
Then edit the colors. Files here are *.json only and are never sourced by zsh.
The '_readme' and '_docs' keys are ignored by the loader (it only reads
variants / palette / claudeCode); leave them, delete them, your choice.
The loader applies the TERMINAL half automatically at shell startup (OSC colors).
The claudeCode half is applied separately by `orca-theme install` (OSC cannot set

_docs.lookup: File basename must equal the repo's Orca displayName + .json (e.g. weather-range.json).
_docs.precedence: central (this dir) BEATS in-repo <worktree>/design/terminal-theme.json BEATS none (reset).
_docs.variants: Loader picks one by env ORCA_THEME_VARIANT: 'day'|'night' (default 'night'; invalid -> night).
_docs.variantColors: background/foreground/cursor are each OPTIONAL; a missing one is not emitted (terminal keeps its default for that slot).
_docs.palette: OPTIONAL 16 positional ANSI slots (0..15), shared across variants; emitted via OSC 4. Omit to keep the terminal's palette.
_docs.claudeCode: OPTIONAL Claude Code half. slug default '<project>-night' (repo-scope it -- the ~/.claude/themes namespace is flat/global). base enum: dark|light|dark-daltonized|light-daltonized|dark-ansi|light-ansi (default dark). 'inactive' is a shorthand folded into overrides.inactive when overrides omits it. 'overrides' is Claude Code's own token->color map; drop the key if unused.
_docs.statusName: OPTIONAL. Color of the PROJECT NAME in the Claude Code statusline (~/.claude/statusline-command.sh). A '#rrggbb' string, or a {"day":"#..","night":"#.."} object (variant-selected). Resolved by `orca-theme statusline-color`; if absent, the statusline falls back to the repo's Orca badgeColor, then to its own default #cc44ff. Pick something readable on the terminal background, since that's what it renders on.
_docs.colorForms: Terminal OSC values should be #rrggbb. Claude Code values also accept #rgb, rgb(r,g,b), ansi256(n), ansi:<name>.
_docs.apply: Run `orca-theme install <repo>` to generate ~/.claude/themes/<slug>.json and set the in-repo selection. Terminal colors apply on next shell (or `orca-theme preview` now).
